# External crate pool desk directory

This directory is stale. It preserves a recorded desk assignment, not confirmation that the assignment remains current.

## Recorded desk
The recorded recipient for a damaged external returnable crate is the Brindle desk at the fictional Ploverloop Crate Pool. Its recorded mailbox is damaged-shells@ploverloop.invalid. All names and addresses here are invented; the address cannot deliver real mail.

## Currency limitation
No current replacement directory or reconfirmation is filed. A response using this entry must explicitly say it is stale and that the assignment needs confirmation. The rack register contains identities and movements, not another contact. Do not silently drop the only recorded source or assert that an old assignment is verified current.
